title: wtxl.1: Regenerate out-of-date tunnel/ipv6/packets vector files
description: generate_*.py --check fails for: tunnel_authorization.json, ipv6-addresses.json, ipv6-icmpv6.json, packets-formats.json, packets-timing.json. Run the generators and commit updated vectors. If the generator output differs from committed bytes, the generators are the oracle — update the committed files.
close_reason: Cannot reproduce — all four generator families now pass --check (exit 0, no drift): generate_tunnel_authorization, generate_ipv6_addresses, generate_ipv6_icmpv6, and generate_packets_timing (which emits BOTH packets-formats.json and packets-timing.json; 14 + 38 vectors verified). The wtxl.4 drift was likely resolved by the vector regenerations that landed with main's sync commits (e.g. 0afb92c647 'test(vectors): regenerate for protocol changes', e5b521e714) after the wtxl report was written (Created Aug 30). Note: tunnel_authorization was ALSO independently re-verified green by worker-6 while working 64l2 (drift closed separately). No vector or generator change needed; closing without commit.
